Myth: more followers will bring you more enquiries.

Fact: thousands of followers who live far away won't book a table.

A cafe in Anna Nagar needs people nearby who can actually walk in. So the content has to speak to them, and the profile has to make booking easy.

That's where enquiries come from. Not the follower count.

Want us to look at your page? Book a free consultation (link in the reply).

post.linkedin_text:
Before you pay a digital marketing agency in Chennai, ask one thing: how do you work?

Because most of the fear around hiring an agency comes from not knowing what happens after you pay.

So here's exactly how we work at Loyara, step by step:

1. Free consultation. We learn about your business, your audience and your goals first. Then we recommend the package that fits. No guessing.

2. You approve the calendar. Every month you get a content calendar to review. Nothing goes into production until you say yes.

3. Content day. We book shoot days in advance and come to your business to film the reels, posts and designs ourselves.

4. Publish, promote, review. We caption and schedule everything, run Meta Ads on Growth and Elite, and go through the results with you on strategy calls.

And payment is simple: 50% before the month's work begins, 50% before final delivery.

I think that's what actually protects you. You know the deliverables, you approve the plan, and you're never paying the full amount for work you haven't seen.

For example, our Growth package is ₹19,999/month: 8 reels, 2 content days, Meta Ads management and a monthly performance report.

It's for Chennai businesses that want to post consistently and get enquiries, but don't have the time to do it themselves.

If you're looking for a digital marketing agency in Chennai, let's talk. Book a free consultation or just DM me.

Which step matters most to you before hiring an agency: 1, 2, 3 or 4?
